dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: Please, look around and buy anything that catches your eye. What you see is what we've got.

dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: As for Sabzeruz Festival souvenirs, or model Flower Carriages, we are currently out of stock.

dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: In response to customer requests, the caravan manager has informed me that they are making more. Please be patient, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: ...Though from what I know of them, by the time they finish, like as not the festival will already be over...
